thesis_statement: Goldman Sachs is the leading global investment bank and a top-tier trading house; a recovering M&A and capital-markets cycle plus a growing asset and wealth management business are producing record revenue and returns on equity above 20%.

base.summary: Deal and trading activity stays healthy and ROE holds in the high teens to low 20s, with steady buybacks.

bull.summary: A multi-year M&A upcycle and capital relief lift ROE and buybacks further.

bear.summary: Capital-markets activity reverts after a record period and the premium to book compresses.

key_risks: Earnings are cyclical: a record quarter (ROE 23.5%) is closer to peak than trough.
Valuation is already elevated at about 2.6x book value versus a long-run average near 1-1.5x.
Overlaps with JPM (both depend on investment banking and markets), so their signals are not independent.
